verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs show real support for custom environments: the Cloud API lets you launch instances with 'a different base image' (custom machine template) and cloud-init for launch-time configuration, plus GPU Base images for full control over the Python environment. Containerized workloads (i.e., running an actual Docker image) are supported via Managed Kubernetes (MK8s) rather than as a first-class ODC instance feature. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of directly launching a Docker image as an ODC instance (vs. VM base image), a custom-image/AMI gallery, and independent hands-on confirmation that custom base images work as claimed.
